#### Geografinės koordinatės

Skills: 3

[geographicCoordinates.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/geographicCoordinates/geographicCoordinates.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The graticule provides a worldwide angular reference for positions. Latitude and longitude are distinct measurements whose ordered combination identifies a location.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Apibūdink vietas Žemėje pagal platumą ir ilgumą.

##### Aiškinti geografinę platumą

[interpretLatitude.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/geographicCoordinates/skills/interpretLatitude.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the Equator as zero latitude and compare how far a point lies toward either pole.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Skaityk platumą kaip vietą į šiaurę arba pietus nuo pusiaujo.

##### Aiškinti geografinę ilgumą

[interpretLongitude.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/geographicCoordinates/skills/interpretLongitude.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use the reference meridian and longitude values to locate east–west positions without confusing them with latitude.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Skaityk ilgumą kaip vietą į rytus arba vakarus nuo atskaitos dienovidinio.

##### Rasti tašką pagal platumos ir ilgumos porą

[locateAPointFromALatitudeLongitudePair.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/geographicCoordinates/skills/locateAPointFromALatitudeLongitudePair.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use both coordinates in their proper order and hemispheres to identify a geographic position.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Rask vietą pagal taisyklinga tvarka pateiktą platumos ir ilgumos porą.

#### Geografinės erdvinės technologijos

Skills: 3

[geospatialTechnologies.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/geospatialTechnologies/geospatialTechnologies.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Satellite and aerial imagery, positioning systems and geographic information systems provide different kinds of geographically referenced evidence. The focus is interpreting and using that evidence for geographic questions, not programming a software package or memorizing individual interface controls.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip palydoviniai vaizdai, vietos nustatymo sistemos ir erdviniai sluoksniai teikia įrodymus.

##### Analizuoti geografinius ryšius pagal erdvinių duomenų sluoksnius

[analyzeGeographicRelationshipsUsingSpatialDataLayers.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/geospatialTechnologies/skills/analyzeGeographicRelationshipsUsingSpatialDataLayers.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Combine separately mapped geographic properties to investigate co-occurrence, proximity or spatial variation, taking account of registration, resolution and the risk of mistaking correlation for causation. GIS is a possible tool rather than the definition of the Skill.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Derink erdvinių duomenų sluoksnius modeliams tirti, bet nelaikyk koreliacijos priežasties įrodymu.

##### Interpretuoti nuotolinio stebėjimo vaizdus

[interpretRemoteSensingImagery.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/geospatialTechnologies/skills/interpretRemoteSensingImagery.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use spatial patterns, scale, source limitations and visible characteristics in aerial or satellite observations to infer geographic features and land-cover change. Comparing two dated images is one application of this competence.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Aiškink aeronuotraukas ar palydovinius vaizdus, kad tyrinėtum geografinius objektus ir pokyčius.

##### Naudoti palydovinio vietos nustatymo duomenis orientacijai

[useSatellitePositioningInformationForGeographicOrientation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/geospatialTechnologies/skills/useSatellitePositioningInformationForGeographicOrientation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret a position supplied by a GNSS device in relation to a coordinate reference and the surrounding geography; recognize that positioning has uncertainty and does not directly describe what is at the location.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Naudok palydovinę vietą, atsižvelgdamas į galimą netikslumą.

#### Gaubliai, žemėlapiai ir projekcijos

Skills: 3

[globesMapsAndProjection.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/globesMapsAndProjection/globesMapsAndProjection.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A spherical Earth cannot be shown on a flat sheet without some distortion, and different representations support different questions. Choosing one is a reasoning decision rather than a display preference.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip žemėlapiai ir gaubliai skirtingai vaizduoja išgaubtą Žemės paviršių.

##### Skirti gaublį ir plokščią žemėlapį kaip Žemės modelius

[distinguishAGlobeFromAFlatMapAsEarthModels.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/globesMapsAndProjection/skills/distinguishAGlobeFromAFlatMapAsEarthModels.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why a globe represents the overall shape of Earth more directly while a flat map is easier to use for selected areas or purposes.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Paaiškink, ką gaublys parodo tiesiogiau nei plokščias žemėlapis.

##### Atpažinti ploto ar formos iškraipymą projekcijose

[recognizeProjectionDistortionInAreaOrShape.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/globesMapsAndProjection/skills/recognizeProjectionDistortionInAreaOrShape.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify that apparent sizes and shapes can change when the curved surface is flattened, especially when comparing distant latitudes.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip Žemės paviršiaus perkėlimas į plokštumą keičia matomus dydžius ir formas.

##### Pasirinkti tikslui tinkamą geografinį vaizdavimą

[selectAGeographicRepresentationForAPurpose.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/globesMapsAndProjection/skills/selectAGeographicRepresentationForAPurpose.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Choose a globe, world or regional map, or detailed street plan according to the required spatial extent, scale and projection properties. This concerns the _representation and coverage_; choosing the subject matter of a political, geological or population map is a separate Skill.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Pagal tikslą pasirink gaublį, didelės teritorijos žemėlapį arba detalųjį planą.

#### Žemėlapių kūrimas ir kartografiniai susitarimai

Skills: 4

[mapDesignAndConventions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapDesignAndConventions/mapDesignAndConventions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Creating and interpreting maps requires deliberate choices of symbols, legends, orientation, scale and labels. Conventions allow readers to infer geographic meaning from an authored representation without treating a map as a literal replica of the ground.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip ženklai, legenda, mastelis ir orientacija padeda suprasti žemėlapį.

##### Kurti žemėlapius

[createMaps.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapDesignAndConventions/skills/createMaps.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Select an appropriate spatial extent and represent places or geographically referenced information with consistent symbols, orientation, labels and scale as needed for a communication purpose. Sketching a classroom plan and constructing a thematic map are applications, not automatically distinct Skills.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sukurk aiškų žemėlapį su tinkamais ženklais, užrašais, kryptimi ir masteliu.

##### Nustatyti žemėlapio orientaciją pagal šiaurės žymą

[determineMapOrientationFromItsNorthIndicator.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapDesignAndConventions/skills/determineMapOrientationFromItsNorthIndicator.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use the map's stated orientation rather than assuming the top of every depiction is geographic north.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Orientuok žemėlapį pagal šiaurės žymą, nemanydamas, kad šiaurė visada viršuje.

##### Aiškinti žemėlapio mastelį kaip atstumų santykį

[interpretAMapScaleAsADistanceRelationship.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapDesignAndConventions/skills/interpretAMapScaleAsADistanceRelationship.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize that a short mark on paper or screen represents a larger distance on the ground and that the ratio changes with scale.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Paaiškink, kaip atstumai žemėlapyje atitinka atstumus vietovėje.

##### Aiškinti sutartinius ženklus pagal žemėlapio legendą

[interpretConventionalMapSymbolsThroughALegend.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapDesignAndConventions/skills/interpretConventionalMapSymbolsThroughALegend.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect a symbol or color to its documented meaning instead of assuming that its appearance is self-explanatory.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Naudokis legenda ir sužinok, ką reiškia žemėlapio ženklai ir spalvos.

#### Žemėlapių tipai ir teminiai sluoksniai

Skills: 3

[mapTypesAndThematicLayers.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapTypesAndThematicLayers/mapTypesAndThematicLayers.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Maps may emphasize general reference features, political territories, physical relief, topography or specific themes such as geology, population, climate, weather, transport and resources. Categories overlap: for example, a geological or population map is thematic, and many maps combine layers. Choosing the relevant content is distinct from choosing a globe or map scale.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip skirtingi žemėlapiai vaizduoja ribas, reljefą, orus, gyventojus ir kita.

##### Atpažinti įprastus žemėlapių tipus pagal jų turinį

[identifyCommonMapTypesByTheirInformationContent.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapTypesAndThematicLayers/skills/identifyCommonMapTypesByTheirInformationContent.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize whether a map presents political boundaries, physical relief, topographic detail, geological units, climate, population, resources or transport, using its title, legend and depicted variables. Explain that reference and thematic are broad roles, not mutually exclusive lists of named maps.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atpažink, kokią geografinę informaciją rodo žemėlapis.

##### Aiškinti teminę legendą ir reikšmių klases

[interpretAThematicLegendAndItsValueClasses.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapTypesAndThematicLayers/skills/interpretAThematicLegendAndItsValueClasses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate mapped color ranges, symbol sizes, or categories to the underlying variable while respecting units and class boundaries.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Naudok temines legendas kategorijoms, intervalams ir vertėms skaityti.

##### Pasirinkti žemėlapio tipą geografiniam klausimui

[selectAMapTypeForAGeographicQuestion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapTypesAndThematicLayers/skills/selectAMapTypeForAGeographicQuestion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Match a question to the type of information a map must show: for example, use a geological map to investigate rock distribution or a population-density map to compare settlement concentration. Do not substitute a visually attractive map lacking the required variable.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Pasirink tinkamą žemėlapio tipą konkrečiam geografiniam klausimui.

### Gamtiniai regionai ir biogeografija

Groups: 3 · Skills: 10

[naturalRegionsAndBiogeography.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Natural conditions create geographic variation in ecosystems, biodiversity and habitat patterns on land and in water. This field describes where ecological regions occur, how their distributions vary and how landscape changes affect them; organism physiology and detailed food-web mechanisms belong primarily to Biology.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Tyrinėk, kaip klimatas, reljefas ir vanduo veikia gyvųjų organizmų geografinį paplitimą.

#### Biomai ir buveinės

Skills: 3

[biomesAndHabitats.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/biomesAndHabitats/biomesAndHabitats.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Broad vegetation and habitat patterns reflect environmental conditions while local ecosystems can be more varied than a single biome label suggests.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kodėl įvairiuose pasaulio regionuose vyrauja skirtingi buveinių tipai.

##### Palyginti buveinių sąlygas skirtingose vietovėse

[compareHabitatConditionsBetweenGeographicLocations.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/biomesAndHabitats/skills/compareHabitatConditionsBetweenGeographicLocations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use temperature, moisture, altitude, and land cover to explain contrasts in living conditions for organisms.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Palygink sąlygas, dėl kurių skirtingose vietose susidaro nevienodos buveinės.

##### Atpažinti pagrindinių sausumos biomų paplitimo dėsningumus

[identifyMajorTerrestrialBiomePatterns.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/biomesAndHabitats/skills/identifyMajorTerrestrialBiomePatterns.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Associate broad forest, grassland, desert, and tundra patterns with environmental conditions rather than treating them as isolated species lists.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atpažink pasaulinius miškų, pievų, dykumų ir tundros paplitimo dėsningumus.

##### Atpažinti pereinamąsias zonas tarp biomų

[recognizeTransitionZonesBetweenBiomes.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/biomesAndHabitats/skills/recognizeTransitionZonesBetweenBiomes.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify that vegetation and environmental conditions may change gradually across boundaries rather than at a perfectly sharp line.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Suprask, kodėl biomų ribos gali keistis palaipsniui, o ne staiga.

#### Ekosistemos

Skills: 4

[ecosystems.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/ecosystems/ecosystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Ecosystems develop under different physical conditions on land and in water, and can vary markedly in spatial extent and connectivity. Geography focuses on the distributions of terrestrial, marine and freshwater environments, their boundaries, fragmentation and regional relationships, rather than organism physiology.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Tyrinėk, kur aptinkamos skirtingos ekosistemos ir kaip jos susijusios kraštovaizdyje.

##### Atskirti jūrų ir gėlavandenių ekosistemas

[distinguishMarineAndFreshwaterEcosystems.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/ecosystems/skills/distinguishMarineAndFreshwaterEcosystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Differentiate aquatic ecosystems shaped by saline ocean or sea water from those associated with predominantly fresh rivers, lakes and wetlands. Use salinity, water movement and geographic connections to explain broad habitat differences; recognize estuaries and other brackish transitional environments instead of forcing every location into one of two categories.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atskirk jūrų, gėlo vandens ir pereinamąsias apysūrio vandens aplinkas.

##### Paaiškinti buveinių fragmentaciją kaip geografinį procesą

[explainHabitatFragmentationAsAGeographicProcess.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/ecosystems/skills/explainHabitatFragmentationAsAGeographicProcess.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate roads, land-cover change or other barriers to the separation of formerly connected habitat areas, recognizing that the ecological consequences depend on species and landscape context.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Paaiškink, kaip keliai ar žemės naudojimo pokyčiai gali padalyti anksčiau susijungusias buveines.

##### Vertinti ryšius tarp natūralių buveinių

[interpretConnectivityBetweenNaturalHabitats.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/ecosystems/skills/interpretConnectivityBetweenNaturalHabitats.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess whether geographic corridors or barriers link habitat patches and enable movement across a landscape, without claiming that proximity automatically guarantees ecological connection.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atpažink natūralius koridorius ir kliūtis tarp buveinių plotų.

##### Aiškinti geografinius biologinės įvairovės dėsningumus

[interpretGeographicPatternsOfBiodiversity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/ecosystems/skills/interpretGeographicPatternsOfBiodiversity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify broad differences in variety of living organisms across mapped regions and relate them cautiously to climate, habitat complexity, disturbance and observation coverage.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Naudok žemėlapius regionų biologinei įvairovei palyginti ir atsižvelk į stebėjimų skirtumus.

#### Aplinkos gradientai

Skills: 3

[environmentalGradients.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/environmentalGradients/environmentalGradients.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Natural conditions often vary systematically with elevation, latitude, and proximity to water. Such gradients help explain patterns without implying that every place at the same latitude is identical.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Tyrinėk, kaip gamta keičiasi priklausomai nuo platumos, aukščio ir artumo vandeniui.

##### Paaiškinti aplinkos pokyčius didėjant geografinei platumai

[explainBroadEnvironmentalVariationWithLatitude.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/environmentalGradients/skills/explainBroadEnvironmentalVariationWithLatitude.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect differences in solar input and circulation to large-scale environmental belts while allowing local exceptions.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Susiek geografinę platumą su bendrais saulės šviesos ir gamtinių sąlygų skirtumais.

##### Nustatyti aplinkos pokyčius lyginant geografinius duomenis

[identifyEnvironmentalShiftsFromComparativeGeographicEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/environmentalGradients/skills/identifyEnvironmentalShiftsFromComparativeGeographicEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use two dated distributions or observations to describe a change in habitat range, without automatically assigning a single cause.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Naudok skirtingų datų žemėlapius ar stebėjimus buveinių pokyčiams pastebėti.

##### Atpažinti gamtinių sąlygų kitimą kylant aukštyn

[recognizeAltitudinalChangesInNaturalConditions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/environmentalGradients/skills/recognizeAltitudinalChangesInNaturalConditions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe how cooler temperatures and vegetation zones can occur higher on mountains without assuming identical patterns everywhere.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atpažink, kaip kylant kalnų šlaitais keičiasi buveinės ir temperatūra.

### Orientavimasis erdvėje

Groups: 4 · Skills: 16

[spatialOrientation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/spatialOrientation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Locating and orienting oneself requires a stable or relative reference, directions, remembered spatial relationships and awareness of changing spatial and temporal frames. These competencies concern where places are, how we navigate between them, and how their civil and solar times relate—not how maps are drawn.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip vietovės, kryptys, maršrutai ir laiko skirtumai padeda orientuotis.

#### Vieta ir atskaitos taškai

Skills: 3

[locationAndReference.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/locationAndReference/locationAndReference.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Locations can be described relative to a chosen reference, identified using stable geographic or civic references, and situated within areas of different spatial extent. The identity of the reference must be explicit rather than assumed from the observer.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Išmok apibūdinti vietas naudodamas aiškius atskaitos taškus.

##### Apibūdinti vietą pagal atskaitos tašką

[describeALocationRelativeToAReferencePoint.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/locationAndReference/skills/describeALocationRelativeToAReferencePoint.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Express where a place lies by referring to another identifiable object or location, such as 'east of the station' or 'next to the bridge'. The statement changes meaning when its reference point changes.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Apibūdink, kur kas nors yra kitos atpažįstamos vietos atžvilgiu.

##### Nustatyti vietą pagal absoliučią nuorodą

[identifyALocationUsingAnAbsoluteReference.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/locationAndReference/skills/identifyALocationUsingAnAbsoluteReference.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use a stable agreed identifier, such as a coordinate pair in a named system or an address within a specified jurisdiction, to locate a place independently of a movable observer. Interpreting latitude and longitude is a separate cartographic competency.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Rask vietą pagal pastovią nuorodą, pavyzdžiui, adresą ar koordinates.

##### Nustatyti vietą vietos, regiono ir pasaulio mastu

[identifyLocationAtLocalRegionalAndGlobalScales.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/locationAndReference/skills/identifyLocationAtLocalRegionalAndGlobalScales.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate the same place to nested areas such as a neighborhood, country, and world region without confusing a change of scale with physical movement.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Surask tą pačią vietą kaimynystės, regiono ir pasaulio mastu.

#### Navigacija ir mintiniai žemėlapiai

Skills: 4

[navigationAndMentalMaps.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/navigationAndMentalMaps/navigationAndMentalMaps.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Moving between places relies on orientation, directional instructions, and sequences of turns. The focus is spatial navigation, not the mathematical calculation of distance.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Išmok orientuotis pagal kryptis, orientyrus ir įsimintus erdvinius ryšius.

##### Sudaryti maršrutą per nuoseklius tarpinius taškus

[constructARouteThroughOrderedWaypoints.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/navigationAndMentalMaps/skills/constructARouteThroughOrderedWaypoints.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Choose an intelligible sequence of landmarks and turns between two positions, checking that the instructions preserve connectivity.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Suplanuok vientisą maršrutą, teisinga tvarka išdėstydamas orientyrus ir posūkius.

##### Orientuotis maršrute pagal pasaulio kryptis

[useCardinalDirectionsToOrientARoute.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/navigationAndMentalMaps/skills/useCardinalDirectionsToOrientARoute.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Associate north, east, south, and west with actual movement or a stated orientation, even when the observer faces a different way.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Eidamas maršrutu naudokis šiaurės, pietų, rytų ir vakarų kryptimis.

##### Skirti kryptis pagal tarpines pasaulio kryptis

[useIntermediateDirectionsToDistinguishBearings.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/navigationAndMentalMaps/skills/useIntermediateDirectionsToDistinguishBearings.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Locate positions such as northeast between adjacent cardinal directions rather than treating the compass as only four separate choices.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atpažink kompase tokias kryptis kaip šiaurės rytai ir pietvakariai.

##### Naudotis mintiniais žemėlapiais orientuojantis erdvėje

[useMentalMapsForSpatialOrientation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/navigationAndMentalMaps/skills/useMentalMapsForSpatialOrientation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Represent remembered places and spatial relationships internally, and use that representation to reason about position or a route without consulting a physical map. Drawing a familiar route, revising it after a new observation and imagining landmarks are different exercises for the same transferable spatial ability.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Remkis vietų prisiminimais, kad suprastum, kur esi ir kaip pasiekti kitą vietą.

#### Erdviniai ryšiai

Skills: 3

[spatialRelationships.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/spatialRelationships/spatialRelationships.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Places and features form patterns of nearness, containment, connection, concentration, and separation. These relationships matter even when the exact names of the locations change.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atpažink, kaip vietos gali būti susijusios, atskirtos ar išsidėsčiusios tam tikrais dėsningumais.

##### Apibūdinti susitelkusį ir išsklaidytą išsidėstymą

[describeClusteredAndDispersedArrangements.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/spatialRelationships/skills/describeClusteredAndDispersedArrangements.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare objects gathered in a small area with objects spread across a larger one while considering the observation scale.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Apibūdink, ar objektai susitelkę, ar išsibarstę.

##### Skirti gretimumą ir artumą

[distinguishAdjacencyFromProximity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/spatialRelationships/skills/distinguishAdjacencyFromProximity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Two territories may share a boundary without being close to the same external landmark; nearby places need not touch.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atskirk besiribojančias vietas nuo tų, kurios tik arti viena kitos.

##### Atpažinti kliūtis ir koridorius tarp vietų

[identifyBarriersAndCorridorsBetweenPlaces.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/spatialRelationships/skills/identifyBarriersAndCorridorsBetweenPlaces.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how a mountain range, river crossing, valley, or road can restrict or enable movement between otherwise nearby locations.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Paaiškink, kaip kalnai, slėniai, keliai ir perėjos veikia keliones tarp vietų.

#### Laiko juostos

Skills: 6

[timeZones.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/timeZones.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Earth's rotation gives different longitudes different solar timing, while societies coordinate clocks through geographically assigned civil time rules. The same place can be described by its solar time, legal time-zone assignment, UTC offset and calendar date; these are related but not interchangeable.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip Žemės sukimasis ir vietinės taisyklės lemia laikrodžių rodomą laiką.

##### Apskaičiuoti civilinį laiką pagal nurodytą UTC poslinkį

[determineCivilTimeUsingASpecifiedUTCOffset.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/skills/determineCivilTimeUsingASpecifiedUTCOffset.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply a stated positive or negative offset to a known UTC time for a particular date, including when the resulting local date moves to the previous or next day. Do not infer an offset from longitude alone.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Rask vietos laiką pagal duotą UTC laiką ir poslinkį, įskaitant datos pasikeitimą.

##### Paaiškinti sezoninius oficialiojo laiko pokyčius

[explainSeasonalChangesToCivilClockTime.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/skills/explainSeasonalChangesToCivilClockTime.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify that some jurisdictions change their legal UTC offsets seasonally while others do not, and that the applicable rule depends on place and date rather than a universal daylight-saving schedule.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kodėl kai kuriose vietose laikrodžiai keičiami pagal sezoną, o kitose ne.

##### Paaiškinti vietinio civilinio laiko sąvoką

[explainTheConceptOfLocalCivilTime.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/skills/explainTheConceptOfLocalCivilTime.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain that the legally observed clock time in a place depends on the jurisdiction and applicable time zone, and can differ from the Sun's position. Civil local time is not the same concept as local solar time, and different places can share one civil clock time.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atskirk teisėtą vietos laikrodžio laiką nuo Saulės laiko.

##### Paaiškinti, kodėl vietinis Saulės laikas priklauso nuo ilgumos

[explainWhyLocalSolarTimeVariesWithLongitude.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/skills/explainWhyLocalSolarTimeVariesWithLongitude.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect Earth's rotation with the apparent passage of the Sun across the sky: places at different longitudes reach solar noon at different moments. This geographic tendency is not a rule that political zone boundaries follow exact meridians.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Paaiškink, kodėl Saulės vidurdienis skirtingose ilgumose būna skirtingu metu.

##### Aiškinti datos pokyčius kertant tarptautinę datų keitimosi liniją

[interpretCalendarDateChangesAcrossTheInternationalDateLine.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/skills/interpretCalendarDateChangesAcrossTheInternationalDateLine.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine why adjacent locations on opposite sides of the approximate Pacific date boundary can have different calendar dates, noting that its actual course follows regional civil-time choices rather than a perfectly straight meridian.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Paaiškink, kodėl peržengus tarptautinę datų keitimosi liniją gali pasikeisti kalendorinė data.

##### Aiškinti laiko juostas geografiniame žemėlapyje

[interpretTimeZonesOnAGeographicMap.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/skills/interpretTimeZonesOnAGeographicMap.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Locate places assigned to different civil time zones using a legend or UTC offsets; recognize that boundaries may follow political borders and that some regions use half-hour or quarter-hour offsets.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Žemėlapyje perskaityk laiko juostų ribas ir UTC poslinkius.

### Vandens sistemos

Groups: 4 · Skills: 13

[waterSystems.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/waterSystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Water connects landscapes through drainage networks, oceans, atmosphere, and underground storage. Geographic questions center on where water moves and accumulates, how its distribution varies, and how water features shape places.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kur Žemėje kaupiamas vanduo, kaip jis juda ir keičia vietoves.

#### Užšalęs ir požeminis vanduo

Skills: 4

[frozenAndSubsurfaceWater.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/frozenAndSubsurfaceWater/frozenAndSubsurfaceWater.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Snow, ice and groundwater store freshwater for different durations and interact with landscapes and human supplies. Their accumulation and discharge vary with climate, geology and geography rather than being visible only in rivers.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip sniegas, ledas ir požeminis vanduo kaupia gėlą vandenį.

##### Ledynų susidarymo ir judėjimo aiškinimas

[explainHowGlaciersFormAndMove.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/frozenAndSubsurfaceWater/skills/explainHowGlaciersFormAndMove.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate sustained snow accumulation and compaction to slowly flowing land ice, distinguishing glaciers from seasonal snow cover and floating sea ice.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Paaiškink, kaip sukauptas sniegas virsta lėtai slenkančiu ledynu.

##### Ledynų poveikio reljefui aiškinimas

[explainHowGlaciersReshapeTerrain.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/frozenAndSubsurfaceWater/skills/explainHowGlaciersReshapeTerrain.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize broad erosional and depositional outcomes of moving land ice, such as glacial valleys, moraines and transported sediment, without treating all U-shaped valleys as proof of one event.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atpažink reljefo formas, kurias ledynai išgraužė arba paliko.

##### Vandeningojo sluoksnio sampratos aiškinimas

[explainTheConceptOfAGroundwaterAquifer.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/frozenAndSubsurfaceWater/skills/explainTheConceptOfAGroundwaterAquifer.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify a permeable geological layer or formation that can store and transmit useful groundwater, distinguishing an aquifer from an open underground lake.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Suprask, kaip laidžios uolienos kaupia ir perduoda požeminį vandenį.

##### Gėlo vandens atsargų geografinių skirtumų aiškinimas

[interpretGeographicVariationsInFreshwaterStorage.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/frozenAndSubsurfaceWater/skills/interpretGeographicVariationsInFreshwaterStorage.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare places in which ice, aquifers, lakes or rivers hold accessible freshwater, recognizing differences in replenishment, seasonal availability and extraction limits.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Palygink ledą, vandeninguosius sluoksnius, ežerus ir upes kaip vandens atsargas.

#### Hidrologiniai ryšiai

Skills: 4

[hydrologicConnections.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/hydrologicConnections/hydrologicConnections.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Water changes location and state among the atmosphere, surface, living systems, and subsurface. This is a connected circulation model rather than a single linear loop.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Pamatyk, kaip vanduo cirkuliuoja tarp oro, sausumos, organizmų ir požeminių atsargų.

##### Vandens prieinamumo regionuose palyginimas

[compareGeographicWaterAvailabilityAcrossRegions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/hydrologicConnections/skills/compareGeographicWaterAvailabilityAcrossRegions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate precipitation, storage, seasonal variation, and demand to differences in accessible fresh water, rather than equating wet weather with secure supply.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Palygink gėlo vandens prieinamumą skirtinguose regionuose.

##### Infiltracijos ir požeminio vandens papildymo aiškinimas

[explainInfiltrationAndGroundwaterRecharge.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/hydrologicConnections/skills/explainInfiltrationAndGroundwaterRecharge.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect water entering permeable soils and rock to subsurface flow and replenishment of groundwater storage, distinguishing a downward pathway from direct surface runoff.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Paaiškink, kaip vanduo patenka į dirvožemį ir uolienas ir papildo požeminį vandenį.

##### Paviršinio nuotėkio aiškinimas

[explainSurfaceRunoffAsAWaterPathway.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/hydrologicConnections/skills/explainSurfaceRunoffAsAWaterPathway.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe water moving across land toward lower terrain and drainage networks when rainfall or melt exceeds infiltration and storage, distinguishing the process from water already stored underground.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Aprašyk, kaip perteklinis lietaus ar tirpsmo vanduo teka žemės paviršiumi.

##### Vandens apytakos aiškinimas

[explainTheHydrologicCycle.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/hydrologicConnections/skills/explainTheHydrologicCycle.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe the movement and storage of water among atmosphere, surface, living systems, ice and subsurface through evaporation, condensation, precipitation and flow. The cycles are multiple interconnected paths, not one mandatory linear sequence.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Paaiškink garavimo, kritulių, kaupimosi ir tekėjimo ryšį.

#### Jūriniai ir pakrančių procesai

Skills: 3

[marineAndCoastalProcesses.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/marineAndCoastalProcesses/marineAndCoastalProcesses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Coastal and marine environments differ in exposure, enclosure, water movement, and relation to land. The emphasis is on geographic patterns and coastal form rather than detailed fluid dynamics.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip bangos, potvyniai ir srovės veikia krantus bei vandenynus.

[identifyCoastalErosionAndDepositionFeatures.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/marineAndCoastalProcesses/skills/identifyCoastalErosionAndDepositionFeatures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate cliffs, beaches, spits, or deltas to material removal and accumulation in their coastal setting.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atpažink pakrantės formas, sukurtas erozijos ir nuosėdų kaupimosi.

##### Vandenyno srovių geografinių dėsningumų aiškinimas

[interpretGeographicPatternsOfOceanCurrents.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/marineAndCoastalProcesses/skills/interpretGeographicPatternsOfOceanCurrents.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize major surface-current directions and geographic effects on coastal climate, transport and marine conditions, without confusing circulation with periodic tidal change.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Aiškink vandenyno srovių pasiskirstymą ir poveikį pakrantėms.

##### Vandenyno potvynių geografinių dėsningumų aiškinimas

[interpretGeographicPatternsOfOceanTides.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/marineAndCoastalProcesses/skills/interpretGeographicPatternsOfOceanTides.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify regional and temporal variations in tidal water levels and their implications for coastlines and navigation, distinguishing tidal cycles from persistent ocean currents.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Palygink potvynius skirtingose pakrantės vietose ir įvairiu laiku.

[identifyTheMainPartsOfARiverNetwork.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/riversAndDrainageBasins/skills/identifyTheMainPartsOfARiverNetwork.data.ts)
